title: Regulatory Procedural Integration
summary: This thread tracks the formal integration of external regulatory frameworks into customs operations, moving from general legal authority to specific cross-referencing of licensing rules and AEO recognition standards.

evolution.scope: Expanded from basic tax authority to comprehensive procedural and status-based regulatory frameworks.

timeline.change: Initial invocation of Customs Act 1969 and VAT Act 1991 for regulatory authority.
Formalizing the hierarchy of rules by mandating the Customs Clearing Agent Licensing Rules 2020 as the fallback regulatory provision.
Expansion of regulatory recognition to include AEO (Authorised Economic Operator) branding and status.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of the Act serves as the legal basis for the government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to issue or amend notifications concerning customs duties.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legislative authority for the government to issue regulatory orders relating to value-added tax in the public interest.
National Board of Revenue: The Board acts as the primary advisory body to the government in the issuance and amendment of customs and tax-related statutory regulatory orders.
S.R.O. 147-AIN/2013: This existing notification is being amended through the replacement of its specified table of goods to update the list of items subject to regulatory provisions.
Animal Feed and Veterinary Products: This order updates the specific list of H.S. codes and descriptions for various items, including feed supplements, veterinary medicines, and related industrial additives, covered under this regulatory framework.
H.S. Code: The table provides a consolidated list of H.S. codes subject to these regulations, covering categories from coral materials and agricultural grains to complex veterinary medicaments and laboratory reagents.

member_objects.clause_title: কাস্টমস এজেন্ট লাইসেন্সিং বিধিমালা অনুযায়ী ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ
member_objects.resolved_text: ২৬। কাস্টমস এজেন্ট লাইসেন্সিং বিধিমালা অনুযায়ী ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ।— এই বিধির অধীন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনার ক্ষেত্রে যদি এমন কোনো বিষয়ের উদ্ভব হয় যাহা এই বিধিমালায় উল্লেখ নাই, সেই সকল ক্ষেত্রে কাস্টমস ক্লিয়ারিং এজেন্ট লাইসেন্সিং বিধিমালা, ২০২০ এর বিধান অনুযায়ী ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা যাইবে।

Customs Clearing Agent Licensing Rules 2: These rules serve as the governing framework for addressing any procedural matters or issues that are not explicitly covered by the current regulatory provisions.
